name: Shaurya Saxena
headline: Head of Technology Services Delivery at Genpact
about:
Delivery Leader for all Capital markets & BFSI accounts in Australia for Genpact with 20 years experience in the IT industry with ability to map and build technology & transformation solutions to business needs with focus on cloud. . I have worked with BIG 5 banks and major insurance clients advising and consulting on their transformation programs.

Past roles include, Program Management, Project Management, Transition Management of complex deals.
Specialties: Delivery Leadership, Program/Delivery Management, Pre Sales, Business Development, Project Management in the Application Outsourcing and Offshore Outsourcing space. Industry experience include, Financial Services - Capital Markets, Investment Banks, Banking, Insurance.
Key responsibilities -
• Client relationship management – manage relationships with operational client personnel
• Business development – drive revenues within the assigned account scope. This involves identifying business opportunities, influencing the client to give additional business based on demonstrated capability and past performance.
• Technology Advisory on legacy modernisation and digital transformation 
• Conduct client presentations, estimation efforts and proposals and negotiations.
• Client delivery assurance – assure the client of the commitment and driving the delivery process by working collaboratively with the Delivery Managers in the business unit.
• Collaborate with the Delivery Manager to address all people or infrastructure related issues that may be affecting the delivery of the project vis-à-vis the specific client.
• Balance different projects running for the client that may involve different Delivery Managers or horizontal competency units’ resources.
• Make pricing decisions within the scope of the Master Services Agreement.

I was handling two key accounts.	
1) The biggest Casino group in Austria		                                                           
Nagarro is their IT partner and we develop and maintain all their Gaming and IT applications. Technology stack is dot net.
2) The biggest security systems group in the world
This group specializes in Wifi, Bluetooth, NFC and hard powered locks. Nagarro develops the softwares that configure and maintain these locks. This project requires hardware integration development and testing. Technology stack is Java, Springs and Hibernate.

Roles and Responsibilities
• Create the project contract, identify stakeholders, understand the requirements
• Follow Agile model for deliveries, perform all scrum ceremonies, automated testing(unit,API and UI testing)
• Tracking on Jira and managing the entire Jira
• Responsible for end to end Account management and growth and client management
• Create Project Plan ,do scheduling and budgeting
• Define project scope, goals, deliverables, Change management plan, risk management plan, quality management plan and communication management plan
• Provide technical improvements in the product and identify client’s pain areas and provide solution for them
• Daily, Weekly and Monthly client reporting
• Manage project financials
• People Management, performance management, recruitment
• Guide the team technically and inculcate innovation in the team
• Support RFPs, Pre-sales activities
